scripts.setup: npm install && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.test:smoke: NO_PROXY='*' ALL_PROXY='' HTTPS_PROXY='' HTTP_PROXY='' playwright test e2e/smoke --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && NO_PROXY='*' ALL_PROXY='' HTTPS_PROXY='' HTTP_PROXY='' playwright test
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run api:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:smoke
scripts.api:check: openapi-typescript ../api/openapi.yaml -o .next/schema.check.ts >/dev/null && cmp -s .next/schema.check.ts src/lib/api/schema.gen.ts || (echo "src/lib/api/schema.gen.ts is stale: run npm run api:types" && exit 1)
